home.heading: Questions before you switch
home.description: Straight answers on fees, safety and moving your accounts.
home.assistanceCopy: A named banker replies within one business day.

items.question: What does an account cost?
items.answer: Everyday accounts are free for the first year. Advisory fees are shown in writing before you sign anything.

items.question: How is my money protected?
items.answer: Deposits are covered by your national guarantee scheme, and every login uses two-factor sign-in.

items.question: Can you move my existing accounts?
items.answer: Yes. Your banker handles the transfer and redirects your regular payments for you.

items.question: Do I need a minimum balance?
items.answer: There is no minimum for everyday banking. Wealth plans start from a sample threshold you can edit.

items.question: Can I bank fully from my phone?
items.answer: Most tasks work in the app, and our branches stay open by appointment.

home-v2.heading: App and account questions
home-v2.description: What to expect when you open an account and start banking from your phone.
home-v2.assistanceTitle: Need a hand with the app?
home-v2.assistanceCopy: Message your banker in the app and get a reply the same business day.

items.question: How long does it take to open an account?
items.answer: Most applications are approved in about ten minutes, and your virtual card is ready to use straight away.

items.question: Which phones does the app support?
items.answer: The app runs on all recent smartphones and tablets, and you can also sign in from any web browser.

items.question: Can I add my card to a mobile wallet?
items.answer: Yes. Add your card to your phone's digital wallet from the app as soon as your account opens.

items.question: What happens if I lose my phone?
items.answer: Call us or sign in on the web to lock the app and your cards. Your money stays protected while you set up a new device.

items.question: Are there fees for spending abroad?
items.answer: Card payments abroad use the live exchange rate with no foreign transaction fee. ATM limits are shown in the app.

services-v1.heading: Questions about our services
services-v1.description: How the six services fit together, and how to choose where to begin.
services-v1.assistanceCopy: Book a short call and an advisor will point you to the right starting place.

items.question: Can I use more than one service?
items.answer: Yes. Most clients combine two or three, and one advisor coordinates all of them under a single plan.

items.question: Is there a minimum to start?
items.answer: Everyday banking has no minimum. Wealth and portfolio services start from sample thresholds you can edit.

items.question: How are service fees charged?
items.answer: Each service lists its fee up front. Ongoing fees are taken monthly and shown on every statement.

items.question: Can I change services later?
items.answer: You can add, pause or close a service at any time, with no exit penalty.

items.question: Who manages my services day to day?
items.answer: Your named advisor leads the relationship, supported by specialists for lending, tax and investments.

services-v2.heading: Business banking questions
services-v2.description: What owners ask before moving company accounts, credit and payroll to us.
services-v2.assistanceCopy: Ask for a call with our business banking lead to plan a group setup.

items.question: What do I need to open a business account?
items.answer: Your company registration number, details of each director and a recent proof of address for the business.

items.question: Can several people use the account?
items.answer: Yes. Add staff with their own cards and set approval rules for payments above a limit you choose.

items.question: Do you offer business credit?
items.answer: We offer overdrafts, term loans and equipment finance, each priced after a review of your accounts.

items.question: Does it connect to accounting software?
items.answer: Transactions sync daily with popular accounting tools, so reconciliation takes minutes.

items.question: Can you help with my personal finances too?
items.answer: Many owners pair business banking with wealth or retirement planning, managed by the same team.

services-v3.heading: Questions about the planning process
services-v3.description: What happens between your first call and your first annual review.
services-v3.assistanceTitle: Want to see a sample plan?
services-v3.assistanceCopy: Ask your advisor for an anonymised example before you commit.

items.question: How long does it take to build a plan?
items.answer: Most plans are written, agreed and funded within four to six weeks of the first call.

items.question: What should I bring to the first meeting?
items.answer: Recent statements for your accounts, pensions and loans, plus a rough idea of your goals.

items.question: Do I have to move my investments?
items.answer: Not always. We review what you hold first and only suggest changes that clearly improve your plan.

items.question: How often is my plan reviewed?
items.answer: You get a quarterly report and a full review every year, plus extra reviews when your life changes.

items.question: Can my partner join the meetings?
items.answer: Yes. We encourage couples to plan together, and both of you get access to the client portal.

pricing.heading: Questions about fees and billing
pricing.description: How we charge, when we charge and what is never charged.
pricing.assistanceCopy: Your advisor can model the exact fees for your balances before you sign up.

items.question: When are fees taken?
items.answer: Monthly plan fees are taken on the first of each month. Percentage fees are worked out daily and charged monthly.

items.question: Are there exit or transfer fees?
items.answer: No. You can move or close any account or portfolio without an exit penalty.

items.question: What does the percentage fee cover?
items.answer: Portfolio management, rebalancing, reporting and advisor reviews. Fund costs are listed separately on every statement.

items.question: Can I switch plans later?
items.answer: Yes. Move up or down at any time, and the new fee applies from the next billing month.

items.question: Do you earn commission on products?
items.answer: Never. We are paid only by your fees, so no recommendation earns us a commission.

contact-v1.heading: Before you get in touch
contact-v1.description: What happens after you send a message or book a meeting.
contact-v1.assistanceCopy: Call our London office and an advisor will pick up during business hours.

items.question: How quickly will someone reply?
items.answer: Every enquiry gets a personal reply from an advisor within one business day.

items.question: Is the first meeting free?
items.answer: Yes. The first conversation carries no cost or obligation, by phone, video or in person.

items.question: Can I meet at a branch?
items.answer: All four branches take appointments. Mention your nearest office when you send the form.

items.question: What should I put in my message?
items.answer: A short note on your goals and timeline is enough. We ask for documents later, only if needed.

items.question: Do you work with clients abroad?
items.answer: We serve clients across Europe by video call, with multi-currency accounts for those living overseas.

contact-v2.heading: Support questions
contact-v2.description: Quick answers for clients who already bank with Vaxmor.
contact-v2.assistanceCopy: Call our card line any time, day or night, to block it straight away.

items.question: How do I reset my app password?
items.answer: Tap Forgot password on the sign-in screen and confirm with your face or fingerprint.

items.question: How do I report a suspicious payment?
items.answer: Freeze your card in the app, then call us. We investigate and update you within two business days.

items.question: Can I change my named banker?
items.answer: Yes. Ask in the app or by email and we will introduce you to another advisor.

items.question: Where do I find my statements?
items.answer: Monthly statements sit in the Documents tab of the app and client portal, going back seven years.

items.question: How do I make a complaint?
items.answer: Email or call us and a senior team member responds within five business days. Sample process, edit for your region.
